title: Hard Hat Economics: Construction costs are up, and that’s okay (for now)
summary: Construction costs are climbing from three directions at once: materials, labor and borrowing. Learn what’s driving the increases, how contractors are keeping margins intact and why the data center boom (and the backlash against it) could determine what comes next.
